_meanings:
.²1 An invitation to begin, bringing near; {#pavamAna˚, prAtaranuvAka˚#} <ab>&c.</ab>
.²2 A term given to certain sentences called {%Praiṣas%} (with which one
 priest calls another to perform a sacrifice).
.²3 Immolation, sacrifice of an animal consecrated according to rites.
.²4 Preparation, beginning, commencement.
.²5 Commencement of reading the Veda after the performance of the preparatory
 rite; <ab>cf.</ab> {#upAkarman#}; {#vedopAkaraRAKyaM karma karizye#} <ls>Śrāvaṇī Mantra.</ls>
